senses.gloss: acquittal, favorable judgment, plea in defence.—לִמֵּד ז׳ to plead in favor of the defendant.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 4:1">Snh. IV, 1</cite> <he>הכל מלמדין ז׳</he> all are permitted to plead for the defendant.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 4:1">Ib.</cite> <he>פותחין לז׳</he> the opening argument must be for the defence.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 4:1">Ib.</cite> <he>מטין על פי אחד לז׳</he> a majority of one is sufficient for acquittal; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:6">Ab. I, 6</cite> <he>הוי דן … לכף ז׳</he> judge every man with an inclination in his favor.
<cite ref="Shabbat 32a:7">Sabb. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>הבא ז׳ והפטר</he> bring pleaders in thy favor (good deeds) and be acquitted; a. fr.
<cite ref="Taanit 29a:11">Taan. 29ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מגלגלין ז׳</he>, v. <cite ref="C00869"><he>גִּלְגֵּל</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 7:1:20">Y. Naz. VII, 56ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>נתכוונתי לז׳</he> I had the intention of doing good; <cite ref="Tractate Semachot 4:34">Treat. S’maḥ. IV</cite>, end. [<cite ref="Tractate Semachot 4:34">Ib.</cite> <he>תחלת זכותי</he>, read: <he>תשמישי</he>.]

senses.gloss: the protecting influence of good conduct, merit.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:50">Y. Peah I, 16ᵇ</cite> top <he>הז׳ יש לה קרן וכ׳</he> good deeds have a capital and interests (reward the author and protect his offspring).—
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 11a:8">R. Hash. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>בז׳ אבות</he> for the sake of the Patriarchs; <he>בז׳ אימהות</he> for the sake of the Mothers (Sarah &c.).
<cite ref="Berakhot 27b:22">Ber. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>לית ליה ז׳ אבות</he> has no distinguished ancestry to rely on.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44:16">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> <he>זְכוּתְךָ עומדת וכ׳</he> thy guarding influence shall stand by them.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 12a:6">Snh. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>בז׳ הרחמים ובזְכוּתָם</he> through Divine mercy and their own merits; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 19a:12">B. Mets. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>ז׳ הוא לעבד וכ׳</he> liberty is a benefit to the slave.
<cite ref="Tosefta Gittin 1:5">Tosef. Gitt. I, 5</cite> <he>היאך נמצא ז׳ וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>מפני מה זכין</he>) how dare we obtain a benefit for this slave?; a. fr.—Pl. <he>זָכִיּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Yoma 86b">Yoma 86ᵇ</cite> <he>זדונות נעשו לו כז׳</he> wilful wrongs are accounted to him (who repents) as though they were merits.
<cite ref="Taanit 20b:8">Taan. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>מנכין לו מזָכִיּוֹתָיו</he> it is deducted from the rewards for his good deeds.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 38:8">Ex. R. s. 38</cite>, end; a. fr.
